tools.name: format_fax_number
tools.description: Turn a fax number as it is printed into international form, resolve which territory it belongs to, and say whether the Faxvio app will dial it and whether its prefix costs two pages per page. Handles the traps: a parenthesised (0), a leading 00 or 011, the shared dial codes, and the countries whose

tools.name: check_fax_destination
tools.description: Whether a fax can be sent to a country, its dial code, the fax carrier's support tier, and the local prefixes that cost two pages per page. Answers "can I fax to X".

tools.name: list_fax_destinations
tools.description: Every country and territory the Faxvio app will send a fax to, optionally filtered to one region.

tools.name: estimate_fax_cost
tools.description: Pages charged, the cheapest mix of packs that covers them and the total in US dollars. Pass the destination number or country and the doubling rule for toll-free, shared-cost and premium prefixes is applied for you.

tools.name: estimate_fax_time
tools.description: How long a fax of N pages takes to send, from ITU-T T.4 page geometry and T.30 session overhead, with its range. Set voip when either end is on an internet line — it caps the modem rate.
